audit_metadata.title: POLARIS EMS HD-05 Battery Degradation Evidence Audit

verdict_summary.meaning_of_degradation: Linear energy throughput penalty acting as an optimization regularizer to prevent micro-cycling.
verdict_summary.c_deg_function: Assigns a static monetary penalty ($0.05/kWh) per unit of charge and discharge energy throughput.
verdict_summary.scientific_support_for_hd05: Can support Option A (throughput proxy in Stage 3) with unit conversion; cannot support physical aging physics without new data.
verdict_summary.missing_evidence: Battery chemistry, cycle-life degradation curves, DoD non-linearity, temperature aging, battery replacement cost, SOH telemetry.
